proposed_handling: Assess requiredness by entity, lifecycle and source coverage; retain blanks and missing-reason categories. No blanket imputation or removal.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic value correction; metadata-only flagging can be automated after implementation approval.
post_correction_validation: Compare required/optional denominators, blank/placeholder counts and complete-row retention; fit any later model-only imputer within training folds.
prediction_impact: Outcome absence, panel zeros and propensity negatives cannot be inferred from missing cells.

proposed_handling: Preserve raw row positions. A future analytical view may exclude proven layout-only rows only under an approved structural rule and with a complete retained/excluded ledger.
automatic_correction_safety: Conditionally automatable in a derivative after explicit structure rule; no deletion from sources.
post_correction_validation: Raw = included + excluded + unresolved, disjoint at the declared source-record scope; no nonblank business row lost.
prediction_impact: Prevents empty layout rows from becoming observations without changing business target mass.

proposed_handling: Keep literal NA/#N/A/null/- and errors separate from blanks; approve token meaning for each field/domain before a derived parse or missing classification.
automatic_correction_safety: No semantic replacement automatically safe; classify/flag raw token only.
post_correction_validation: Token frequencies and raw-to-derived reason mapping conserved; no legitimate code/token converted to missing.
prediction_impact: Avoids fabricated zeros, broken identity and silently altered outcome denominators.

proposed_handling: Record raw token, source format candidates and interpretation status; use only owner-approved per-field formats/century rules later. No global dayfirst or inference from neighbouring rows.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic date resolution before approval.
post_correction_validation: Format-specific parse/round-trip; ambiguity and century counts reconcile; original tokens and alternative readings stay available.
prediction_impact: Event ordering, temporal buckets, horizon and leakage checks depend on this approval.

proposed_handling: Flag unresolved; request traceable source correction or approved exception policy. Do not roll dates, clamp month ends or shift years.
post_correction_validation: Calendar validity plus source correction reference; before/after exception counts and impact on period coverage reconciled.
prediction_impact: Invalid event times cannot create valid-looking history or outcome windows.

proposed_handling: Confirm numeric field role, workbook epoch and date range; retain numeric token and proposed interpretation separately until approved.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic numeric-to-date conversion before role/epoch approval.
post_correction_validation: Explicit epoch/unit tests and raw-to-derived provenance; non-date identifiers/measures never converted.
prediction_impact: Prevents false history and accidental transformation of ordinary numbers into timestamps.

proposed_handling: Keep raw values; establish actual/planned/available roles. Define cutoff-specific eligibility views and reasons, not destructive deletion.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic correction or historical inclusion based on date alone.
post_correction_validation: Check availability<=decision cutoff for allowed inputs and outcome maturity; compare old review date with current contract cutoff explicitly.
prediction_impact: Avoids training on future/planned outcomes and accidental hindsight features.

proposed_handling: Identify whether periods are complete, partial, unobserved, ineligible or no-activity using extraction and business calendar evidence. No automatic reindex/zero fill.
post_correction_validation: Bucket completeness and boundaries proven; observed/zero/unknown/partial states remain distinct; temporal-support requirements assessed by contract.
prediction_impact: Affects forecast support, seasonality and defensible negative purchase windows.

proposed_handling: Retain exact, payload and proposed transaction-signature groups; approve occurrence identity, source precedence and legitimate split-line policy before any derivative selection.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic deduplication safe under current key/grain evidence.
post_correction_validation: Group membership versus excess counts reconciled; retained/excluded occurrence lineage, reasons and signed/absolute quantities/amounts conserved under approved policy.
prediction_impact: Avoids double counting and removal of valid repeated movements, opening balances or split transactions.

proposed_handling: Separate exact repetitions from conflicting attributes and legitimate history; require scoped identity and effective/available-time crosswalk, not first/last-row selection.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic merge, latest-row winner or master dedup safe.
post_correction_validation: Unique eligible target per approved scope/time; conflicts explicit; before/after join cardinality and coverage rechecked.
prediction_impact: Prevents fanout or future master attributes entering earlier predictions.

proposed_handling: Retain orphan/unresolved references with source locator; request approved crosswalk/scope or additional master coverage. No generated business IDs or name-only fuzzy repairs.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic identity correction; unmatched/blank flagging only.
post_correction_validation: Null and orphan counts, distinct-key coverage both ways, collisions and point-in-time referential rules; no silent inner-join loss.
prediction_impact: Defines eligible entity series/population; unmatched does not mean inactive or nonpurchasing.

proposed_handling: Keep raw values. Propose derived normalization by approved namespace/domain; detect collisions and preserve equivalence mapping. Flags require explicit true/false/unknown domain.
automatic_correction_safety: Conditionally automatable only after approved semantics and collision checks; fuzzy spelling merges never automatic.
post_correction_validation: Raw and derived distinct counts, collision groups, leading-zero preservation, changed-record ledger and encoding round-trip.
prediction_impact: Prevents collapsing distinct customers/products or converting unknown flags into negative outcomes.

proposed_handling: Keep raw token and parse status; approve field role, units/currency/locale and strict grammar before derived numeric parsing. Pricing-unit/stock-impact flags are not financial amounts.
automatic_correction_safety: Conditionally automatable after unit/locale/role approval; unsupported strings remain unresolved.
post_correction_validation: Valid grammar and unit/locale tests; parse failures counted separately from blank/zero; round-trip/provenance and financial controls.
prediction_impact: Prevents silent zero imputation and mixing identifiers, units and measures.

proposed_handling: Review returns, cancellations, adjustments, rates and unit conventions. Preserve values until a documented business rule identifies an error.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic abs, sign flip, zero replacement or row deletion safe.
post_correction_validation: Context-specific sign/zero/fraction rules; signed and absolute sums and counts reconciled; no blanket positivity assumption.
prediction_impact: Legitimate returns/adjustments must remain in the approved target definition.

proposed_handling: Treat IQR flags as review evidence, not errors; assess context and source evidence. Later model-only robust transforms, if approved, must be fitted within training folds.
post_correction_validation: Raw tails and exceptions retained; approved change policy and fold-contained transform provenance; before/after target mass reviewed.
prediction_impact: Protects rare legitimate demand/transactions and avoids holdout leakage.

proposed_handling: Review additive grain, unit, discount, freight, tax, rounding, sign and filing rules with finance; retain source amounts. Do not overwrite reported values to match a formula.
post_correction_validation: Owner-approved formula/tolerance/context; line/document/adjustment reconciliation and exception ledger; no duplicated totals.
prediction_impact: Affects value/tax targets and evaluation labels; recognized revenue remains unsupported without ledger evidence.

proposed_handling: Tag approved source-use scope in metadata; do not treat cleaning as validation of production authenticity or combine with real data by default.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic promotion to production safe.
post_correction_validation: Source marker, lineage and allowed-use decision visible in every derivative; no production-performance claim from examples.
prediction_impact: Synthetic histories cannot certify actual demand, customer behavior or FX outcomes.

proposed_handling: Keep blank original header plus position and raw values. Request semantic confirmation; a display locator is not a new business column name.
post_correction_validation: Original blank-header metadata and 33 populated values preserved; approved binding, if any, explicitly versioned.
prediction_impact: Unconfirmed agency/source interpretation cannot drive product grouping or joins.

issue_family: Unclassified issue or new schema condition
proposed_handling: Retain evidence, stop dependent use and request scoped review. New quality rules must have explicit lineage, proposed treatment and approval status.
automatic_correction_safety: No automatic correction; fail closed for dependent semantic use.
post_correction_validation: Issue has an owner, valid scope/counts, evidence, treatment proposal and post-treatment acceptance criteria before release.
prediction_impact: New sources/tasks are assessed through metadata contracts rather than a hardcoded scenario exception.
